newsitem.title: USA: Buckeye offers C$6.00/shr for Merfin Intl. [corrected 14:30 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Buckeye offers C$6.00/shr for Merfin Intl. [corrected 14:30 gmt]

text.p: Buckeye Cellulose Corp said Tuesday it was making a tender offer of C$6.00 per share for all issued and outstanding shares of Merfin International Inc.
The offer is subject to receipt of at least 75 percent of Merfin's shares, and the removal or waiver of Merfin's recently announced shareholder rights plan, Buckeye said.
The offer will be open through April 15 unless withdrawn or extended, Buckeye said.
On March 17 Merfin announced it had received an unsolicited takeover offer from an unnamed U.S. company. (Corrects to make clear that Merfin received, rather than made, the offer.)
Buckeye said its C$6.00-per-share offer represents a 45 percent premium over Merfin's 30-day weighted average price prior to the March 17 announcement.
Merfin shares closed at C$5.950 Monday. Buckeye closed at 30-3/4.
